output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the owner calls mintToken, the amount of tokens to be minted is added to the target's balance without a check, allowing the balance of the contract to become very large, and in the worst case, become non-mintable.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to] is true, it indicates an overflow, but the function still adds _value to balanceOf[_to], causing unexpected token distribution.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to] is true, it indicates an overflow, but the function still adds _value to balanceOf[_to], causing unexpected token distribution.
The buy function has a wrong logic vulnerability. When the contract has insufficient balance, it allows attackers to buy tokens, and in the worst case, attackers can make the contract unusable.
The sell function has a wrong logic vulnerability. When the contract fails to send funds, it allows attackers to sell tokens, and in the worst case, attackers can make the contract unusable.
